itens.trecho: Um Bom Dia Para Matar "Die Hard". A franquia “Die Hard” já teve os seus momentos de glória e ajudou muito a consolidar a carreira de Bruce Willis. O primeiro filme e o terceiro da foram realmente muito bons e bem executados. O segundo filme, não tão bom, teve também momentos de mérito.

Big, dumb, fun action flick in Russia dies hard to entertain RELEASED IN 2013 and directed by John Moore, "A Good Day to Die Hard" is the Third of (currently) five installments in the Die Hard series. In this one John McClane (Bruce Willis) travels to Moscow to aid his unruly son, Jack (Jai Courtney), only to discover that Jack is an undercover agent.

My god what a disappointment! The original movie had a script worth watching and some good action and special effects. This one, well this was a typical Hollywood script written by someone who either was incredibly stupid or just too arrogant to care. It is a script that I would expect from a SyFy channel production.
